app.title: Canada Post Claim Runner
app.subtitle: Import history, identify late-delivery candidates, and submit selected candidates in one place.
setup.title: Welcome — readiness setup
setup.intro: Canada Post Claim Runner keeps credentials, operational records, and browser sessions on this device. Setup never tests an account or submits a claim automatically.
setup.safety: Start with dry run. Live submission remains separately acknowledged and blocked until a reviewed queue passes preflight. CAPTCHA and text verification stay manual in the visible built-in browser.
setup.safetyAcknowledge: I understand that setup does not authorize Step 2 or Step 3, and that live submission requires separate supervised gates.
setup.step.local.title: Local-only data
setup.step.local.detail: Private application storage and database health. Runtime data stays outside the installation.
setup.step.storage.title: Secure credential storage
setup.step.storage.detail: Website and API secrets are encrypted locally and are never prefilled back into forms.

setup.step.website.detail: Enter the Canada Post website account identifier; setup does not attempt a login.

setup.step.api.detail: Store the dedicated Tracking API 2.0 client ID and secret for the selected environment.
setup.step.diagnostic.title: One-shipment API diagnostic
setup.step.diagnostic.detail: Deliberately test one authorized shipment before Step 2; no claim or queue state is changed.
setup.step.sender.title: Customer, sender, and contact
setup.step.sender.detail: Complete the original shipment customer number and claim contact fields.
setup.step.dryRun.title: Dry-run readiness
setup.step.dryRun.detail: Review advisory policy guidance and use the built-in browser; dry run stops before any final action.
setup.step.external.title: External checks
setup.step.external.detail: Network, account access, CAPTCHA, text verification, legal approval, and real claims require supervised human action.

step2.candidateExplanation: This step compares the successful-delivery date against the original Delivery Standard. A shipment becomes a late-delivery candidate when successful delivery occurred after that standard. First-attempt, service, policy, and claim-window information remains advisory. Canada Post makes the final eligibility decision.
